description.en: A client-generated token that must be unique across requests to ensure idempotency. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no longer than 64 characters.
The ID of the region where the VBR is located. You can call the `DescribeRegions` operation to get the latest region list.
The secondary IPv4 CIDR block of your on-premises data center. This parameter is used for disaster recovery in a dual-homed configuration.
The ID of the VBR to recover.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs recover-virtual-border-router --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-id example-string --client-token example-string --user-cidr example-string --region cn-hangzhou
